text.setup: Face a wall in a short split stance with the front toes about a hand's width from the wall.
cues: Drive the front knee forward to touch the wall while the heel stays down.
Move the foot back a little when it gets easy.

text.setup: Stand side-on to a wall or rack and hold it with one hand.
cues: Swing the outside leg forward and back in a relaxed arc.
Let the range grow gradually.

text.setup: Face a wall or rack and hold it with both hands.
cues: Swing one leg across the body and out to the side.
Keep the torso still.

name: Deep squat hold with elbow push

text.setup: Sink into the deepest comfortable squat, holding a support or a light weight at your chest.
cues: Use your elbows to gently push the knees outwards.
Shift slowly from side to side.

text.setup: Step forward into a long lunge and place the opposite hand on the floor inside the front foot.
cues: Turn the chest and reach the other arm to the ceiling.
Return the hand and step through to the other side.

text.setup: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at right angles, one leg in front and one to the side.
cues: Rotate both knees over to the other side without using your hands if you can.
Sit tall throughout.

text.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
cues: Lift the hips and squeeze the glutes for two seconds at the top.
Lower slowly.

text.setup: Stand tall, then fold forward and place your hands on the floor, bending the knees as needed.
cues: Walk the hands out to a plank.
Walk them back and stand up.

text.setup: Start on hands and knees.
cues: Slowly round the back up towards the ceiling, then let it sink and lift the chest.
Move with your breath.

text.setup: Lie on your side with knees bent and stacked, arms straight out in front together.
cues: Open the top arm across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Keep the knees together on the floor.

text.setup: Stand with your back to a wall, forearms against it with elbows bent like goalposts.
cues: Slide the arms up as far as you can while keeping contact with the wall.
Slide back down, squeezing the shoulder blades down.

text.setup: Hold a high plank (or an incline plank with hands on a bench) with straight arms.
cues: Let the chest sink between the shoulder blades without bending the elbows.
Push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades.

text.setup: Hold a light band at chest height with straight arms.
cues: Pull it apart to the chest and return slowly.

text.setup: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
cues: Make slow circles that grow bigger, then reverse direction.

text.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with feet able to touch a box if needed.
cues: Relax the body and breathe.
Gently pull the shoulders down for the last few seconds.

text.setup: Kneel with hands flat on the floor under your shoulders.
cues: Rock gently forward and back over the hands.
Stay within a comfortable range.

text.setup: Walk slowly in a clear space.
cues: Pull one knee to your chest while rising onto the standing toes.
Step forward and repeat on the other side.

text.setup: Stand tall with one hand on your belly and one on the side of your waist.
cues: Breathe in to expand under both hands.
Tighten the stomach as if bracing for a light poke and hold for 5 seconds.

text.setup: Stand next to a wall or sturdy rail with one hand hovering just above it.
cues: Lift one foot and hold steady.
Touch the support whenever you need to; progress by looking up or turning your head slowly.

text.setup: Stand beside a wall or rail in a clear space.
cues: Walk forward placing the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes of the other.
Keep a hand near the support.

text.setup: Stand on one leg beside a support.
cues: Tap the free foot lightly forward, to the side and behind, like the hands of a clock.
Keep the standing knee soft and steady.

text.setup: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
cues: Squeeze the glute of the kneeling side and shift the hips forward slightly.
Breathe slowly; you should feel the front of the hip stretch.

text.setup: Lie on your back and loop a towel or band around one foot.
cues: Raise the straight leg until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.

text.setup: Stand holding a support and bend one knee to hold the foot behind you.
cues: Keep the knees together and the hips pushed slightly forward.

text.setup: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
cues: Pull the uncrossed thigh gently towards you until you feel the stretch in the crossed side's buttock.

text.setup: Place your hands on a wall and step one foot back.
cues: Keep the back heel down and the back knee straight, then lean in gently.

text.setup: Stand with feet wide apart and toes forward.
cues: Bend one knee and shift sideways until you feel a stretch in the straight leg's inner thigh.

text.setup: Stand in a doorway or beside a rack upright and place your forearm against it at shoulder height.
cues: Turn the body gently away until you feel the chest stretch.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.

text.setup: Kneel facing a bench and rest your elbows or hands on it.
cues: Sit the hips back and let the chest sink towards the floor.

text.setup: Kneel and sit your hips back towards your heels.
cues: Walk the hands forward and let the forehead rest on the mat or your fists.
Breathe into the back.

text.setup: Sit or lie comfortably.
cues: Breathe in through the nose for about 4 seconds.
Breathe out slowly for about 6 seconds and let the shoulders drop.
